scope: first 13 representative layouts; before and after; native Canvas MP4, no UI recordings
limitations: Six sampled frames per video cannot certify motion continuity or absence of an intervening freeze/collision.
Circle guide is absent from native PNG; hold positioning was assessed against manifest circle coordinates, not a visible overlay.
Ticker scrolling auxiliary lyrics/band remain an existing AVOID-018 masking task; no global all-ink-avoids-circle claim.
circleAssessment: After main lyrics and meaningful owned labels/frames appear outside the circle at sampled hold images; ticker auxiliary band is the known exception. No apparent new clipping, mojibake, vanished layout, or HTML UI contamination in viewed evidence.
